verdict.rationale: Flagsmith supports toggling flags per environment (gh-2), issues a distinct non-secret Environment Key per environment for SDK authentication (docs-15), lets RBAC restrict who can modify production environments (docs-26), and exposes environment CRUD via the Admin API (docs-16). This directly covers independent environment flag states and scoped SDK keys per environment. Missing for 10: a first-party walkthrough explicitly showing dev/staging/prod setup end-to-end, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond docs.
